items.title: Add ignored root authority_trust.env support for Authority config resolution
items.context: User provided /Users/jek/Documents/Work/Koala/cord-team/authority_trust.env and wants it placed at the Lattice CLI root for default Authority Server connection. The fix must keep secrets untracked, load the file only for Authority config paths, map LIVE_URL/LIVE_PUBLIC_KEY/CUSTOMER_API_KEY_FILE aliases to canonical LATTICE_AUTHORITY_* fields, and preserve precedence: explicit CLI/env overrides win over the file.
items.userSees: 运行 lattice authority_status --authorityMode=enforce --json 时，根目录 authority_trust.env 中的 URL/key path/public key 会被当作默认 Authority 配置读取；显式 env/CLI 覆盖仍然优先。

happy.desc: authority_trust.env with LIVE_URL/LIVE_PUBLIC_KEY/CUSTOMER_API_KEY_FILE resolves to canonical Authority config when explicit env is absent

edge.desc: explicit LATTICE_AUTHORITY_URL and CUSTOMER_API_KEY_PATH override authority_trust.env values
missing authority_trust.env remains non-fatal and falls back to existing authority.md/default behavior

adversarial.desc: authority_trust.env remains gitignored and real secret values are not printed or committed

items.title: Verify Authority status uses the default trust file without Authority overclaim
items.context: Authority default loading must improve readiness diagnostics and connection inputs, but must not set authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone or claim receipt verification without a real Authority receipt.
